# Dimension 3: AI & LLM Integration

Reference file for [citations.md](../citations.md).

## LangChain Integration

n8n integrates LangChain's JavaScript framework directly into its visual canvas
[2][23]. The integration provides over 70 dedicated AI nodes [23] with
specialized typed sub-connections: AI Language Model, AI Memory, AI Tool, AI
Retriever, AI Text Splitter, AI Embedding, AI Document [23].

Prior to version 1.82.0, the AI Agent had multiple types (Conversational,
OpenAI Functions, Plan and Execute, ReAct, SQL). As of v1.82.0+, all work
as Tools Agent [23].

## AI Root Nodes

| Node | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| AI Agent | Goal-oriented agent with tool use (6 types) [2] |
| Basic LLM Chain | Fundamental language model operations [2] |
| Question and Answer Chain | Retrieval-based QA [2] |
| Summarization Chain | Content condensation [2] |
| Information Extractor | Structured data extraction [2] |
| Text Classifier | Text categorization [2] |
| Sentiment Analysis | Emotional tone detection [2] |
| LangChain Code | Custom LangChain implementations [2] |

tasks [2].

## RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

n8n provides comprehensive RAG implementation [22]:
- Document insertion with chunking and vectorization
- Query through agents or direct node access
- Integration with 500+ native integrations for data sources [22]
- Templates available for Google Drive, Notion integration [22]

## Structured Output

| Parser | Method | Source |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Structured Output Parser | JSON Schema or generated from example | [2] |
| Item List Output Parser | List extraction | [2] |
| Auto-fixing Output Parser | Auto-correction on parse failures | [2] |

**Limitation:** Structured Output Parser not reliable for intermediary agent
outputs. Recommended to use separate LLM chain for agent output parsing [23].

Calculator, Custom Code, MCP Client, SearXNG, SerpApi, Wikipedia, Wolfram|Alpha

## Gaps and Limitations

- Exact count of AI nodes varies between sources: "70+" [23], with some
  counting sub-nodes differently
- LangChain JavaScript version not specified in accessible documentation
- No published performance comparison between vector store backends
- Structured Output Parser limitation with agents is a known design constraint
  [23]
- Ollama integration: no data on feature parity gaps vs cloud providers
